label: Sample profile (synthetic): automation freelancer
note: Fictional sample data so anyone can rerun the test set. It is not a real person. Real users keep their own projects in their private workspace.

projects.title: Lead intake automation with n8n
projects.problem: Leads from the website's forms were copied into a spreadsheet by hand, with duplicates and slow follow-up.
projects.what_i_did: Built an n8n workflow: form webhooks, field validation, a duplicate check by email, a new Google Sheets row and a Slack alert to the sales channel.
projects.result: Lead entry dropped from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes.

projects.title: Shopify to PostgreSQL inventory sync
projects.problem: Stock counts in the store and the warehouse database drifted apart, so items oversold.
projects.what_i_did: Wrote a Python service that listens to Shopify inventory webhooks, reconciles counts against PostgreSQL on a schedule and logs every change.
projects.result: Stock synced every 15 minutes, with no oversold orders in the first month.

projects.title: Support inbox triage with an LLM
projects.problem: A small support team sorted every incoming email by hand.
projects.what_i_did: Built a Python job that reads new Gmail messages, classifies them with the Gemini API, writes them to Airtable and leaves low-confidence ones for a person to review.
projects.result: About 300 emails a week sorted into 6 categories; low-confidence ones go to a person.
